newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone, Omnipoint in roaming deal.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone, Omnipoint in roaming deal.

text.p: British mobile phone operator Vodafone said on Tuesday it had opened the way for a commercial roaming contract with U.S. counterpart Omnipoint of New York.

"A commercial agreement will be in place within a few weeks which will allow Vodafone subscribers to travel to New York and use their UK Vodafone SIM (identity and billing) card in a 1900 Mhz handset to make and receive calls in the usual way, on their usual number, by using the Omnipoint network," the firm said.
Its statement added that, in parallel, Omnipoint subscribers would be able to use their SIM cards to link up to Vodafone's GSM network in Britain. Roamed calls would be billed at home.

"This link-up has been much anticipated by mobile phone users on both sides of the Atlantic and it is going to be an enormously popular service," Vodafone managing director David Channing Williams was quoted as saying.
Vodafone already has 78 commercial GSM roaming agreements with mobile phone operators in 52 countries worldwide.
The deal is Omnipoint's third internationally and its first in Britain.
